Also refer me good books on dawah which help in inviting people to do tabligh in the lights of QURAN AND HADITH. Jazakumullah Answer ID: 10100 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 56/56=M/1429) For Jannah and Jahannam, you can study these books: Jannat ke Haseen Manazir, Jahannam ke Khaufnak Manazir, Dozakh ka khatka. For rules and regulation of Dawah and Tabligh, study: Dini Dawat ke Qurani Usool (Hadhrat Qari Tayyib Sahib), Usool-e-Tabligh (Hadhrat Maulana Masihullah Sahib) and Dawat-o-Tabligh ke Rahnuma Usool (ifadat of Hadhrat Thanvi, compiled by Mufti Zaid Mazahiri Nadwi). Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
